licence_note: Aggregate summary statistics of the AIT Log Data Set V2.1 (Landauer et al., Zenodo record 19483937, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) - summary statistics only; no row-level data. No window, feature vector, log line, IP address, timestamp or host name is included (only the three generic host role ids). Every statistic aggregates at least min_support real windows: smaller groups are null, and a statistic with smaller support is inherited from the next coarser group (listed in inherited_features). 'upper' is the min_support-th largest real value, not the maximum, so no single window's value is disclosed. See LICENSE-DATA.

copula.method: gaussian copula; pooled within-(replica, host) correlation of normal scores
